audience: e-commerce teams that run Searchanise search on their online store

useCases.title: Test what shoppers see for a search term
useCases.text: Run a search term as the results widget does, with optional filters. Then request the suggestions a shopper sees while typing that term.

useCases.title: Find products by a size or price filter
useCases.text: Search a term with a filter, such as a size attribute or a price range. Read the matching products with their prices and quantities.

useCases.title: Check that new products are indexed
useCases.text: Read the index status, the full import state and the product count. Confirm that the latest product data is searchable.

useCases.title: Remove a discontinued item from search
useCases.text: Delete one product, category or page from the search index by its numeric id. The store catalog stays unchanged. The removal takes some minutes, and a re-import restores the item.
